name: Suspicious Partner
description: Noh Ji-Wook is a prosecutor in the Central District Prosecutors’ Office who ends up switching professions to a private attorney. He harbors a trauma stemming from an event in his childhood involving his parents and his first love. Eun Bong-Hee, a Taekwondo athlete in her youth, is a prosecutor trainee who has become a murder suspect. Eun Bong-Hee and Noh Ji-Wook both find themselves being the focus of a killer.

videos.title: Hope for the Future (1)
videos.overview: Eun Bong-Hee seeks revenge on her cheating boyfriend, but her knight in shining armor turns out to be Noh Ji-Wook, a prosecutor she earlier accused of being a pervert.

videos.title: Hope for the Future (2)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee secures herself a legal internship, unaware that her instructor will be Ji-Wook, who remembers her antics well.

videos.title: The Murder (1)
videos.overview: The tables are turned when Bong-Hee suddenly finds herself accused of murder. The situation only worsens when Ji-Wook is made the case's prosecutor, his future dependent on her confession.

videos.title: The Murder (2)
videos.overview: Ji-Wook finds a bloody knife at the scene of the crime that could greatly affect the case. Bong-Hee's murder trial begins.

videos.title: Interpretation of a Juristic Act (1)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee tries to find Hee-Joon's real murderer, but her only hint is a melody. Ji-Wook has trouble adjusting to no longer being a prosecutor.

videos.title: Interpretation of a Juristic Act (2)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook take on opposing clients, but they realize they must work together when things go awry.

videos.title: Reunion and Reunion (1)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee has a close encounter with the culprit. Ji-Wook notices District Attorney Jang keeping an eye on Bong-Hee.

videos.title: Reunion and Reunion (2)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee searches for work while living at Ji-Wook’s house. Ji-Wook’s ex, Yoo-Jung, comes back to town with a mission in her mind.

videos.title: Mankind, Held Hostage (1)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee pretends to be Ji-Wook's girlfriend in front of Yoo-Jung. Ji-Wook hands in his resignation letter.

videos.title: Mankind, Held Hostage (2)
videos.overview: Ji-Wook sets up his own law firm and begins recruiting employees. Lawyer Ji’s backstory with Ji-Wook is revealed.

videos.title: The Beginning That Hasn't Begun (1)
videos.overview: Ji-Wook quickly becomes frustrated with his newly-assembled team. The suspect of a murder and robbery case requests Bong-Hee as his lawyer.

videos.title: The Beginning That Hasn't Begun (2)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee has a dangerous confrontation with District Attorney Jang. Jung Hyun-Soo’s lack of an alibi creates difficulty for Ji-Wook’s team.

videos.title: Alibi (1)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee struggles to reset her feelings for Ji-Wook after being denied. Details of a past assault case arise concerning Jung Hyun-Soo.

videos.title: Alibi (2)
videos.overview: Ji-Wook faces off with unreliable witnesses in the courtroom. Later, he answers a call that could change everything.

videos.title: Untruthful Truth and Dare (1)
videos.overview: Ji-Wook tries to find out more about Hyun-Soo while keeping his team in the dark. Lawyer Ji's excitement for a special day is quickly dampened.

videos.title: Untruthful Truth and Dare (2)
videos.overview: Hyun-Soo begins to catch on to Ji-Wook's suspicions. Bong-Hee has trouble moving on from Ji-Wook when he can't seem to leave her alone.

videos.title: Eun Bong-Hee's Golden Age (1)
videos.overview: Go Chan-Ho resorts to desperate measures to get away from Hyun-Soo. Ji-Wook comes to terms with his feelings, but is he too late?

videos.title: Eun Bong-Hee's Golden Age (2)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee decides to help lawyer Byun out with his "heroic" DUI case. District Attorney Jang asks Yoo-Jung and Ji-Hye to help him reinvestigate Hee-Joon's murder.

videos.title: Truth vs Secrecy (1)
videos.overview: Lawyer Ji receives a strange request from a client and is faced with a dilemma he can't consult his team on.

videos.title: Truth vs Secrecy (2)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee becomes determined to figure out the Park Sung-Eun case, even if she has to forgo bathing. Ji-Wook tells Bong-Hee about his family’s past.

videos.title: In This Finite World (1)
videos.overview: Ji-Wook takes on a seemingly psychic client who has a vision that could affect more than just his case. Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook receive a new clue regarding Hee-Joon’s murder.

videos.title: In This Finite World (2)
videos.overview: A frightening realization comes crashing down on Bong-Hee. So Jung-Ha's predictions freak out the firm.

videos.title: 48 Hours Later (1)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee’s old friend calls her for help after she’s attacked. Ji-Wook’s firm wants to continue investigating Jung Hyun-Soo, but they need help.

videos.title: 48 Hours Later (2)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook search for a witness or a weapon from Yeon-Woo's attack. Social media-savvy Lawyer Ji then takes things into his own hands.

videos.title: Attributable Reasons (1)
videos.overview: Chief Bang is rushed to the hospital, his fate unknown. Tensions rise at the firm as Ji-Wook begins thinking about revenge.

videos.title: Attributable Reasons (2)
videos.overview: The firm contemplates if fabricating evidence is their only option for having Hyun-Soo arrested.

videos.title: The Memory of That Day (1)
videos.overview: Hyun-Soo is admitted to the hospital while still unconscious, therefore putting his arrest on hold. Ji-Wook wonders who could have planted the bloody knife.

videos.title: The Memory of That Day (2)
videos.overview: An arson case brings back painful memories of the past. Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook go out on an arcade date, but run into unexpected company.

videos.title: Postponement (1)
videos.overview: Ji-Wook is at a loss after seeing the photo on Bong-Hee's nightstand, and he decides to delve deeper into the past.

videos.title: Postponement (2)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee notices Ji-Wook's strange behavior as they investigate the arson case. Eun-Hyuk goes to Yoo-Jung for help.

videos.title: The Discovery of a Memory (1)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee breaks up with Ji-Wook, but is left with nowhere to go. Ji-Wook goes to see District Attorney Jang.

videos.title: The Discovery of a Memory (2)
videos.overview: A child from Bong-Hee's Taekwondo classes witnesses a murder, but claims he doesn't remember the killer's face.

videos.title: Testing the Waters (1)
videos.overview: Hyun-Soo wakes up, but seemingly can't remember anything, which leaves Ji-Wook suspicious.

videos.title: Testing the Waters (2)
videos.overview: The firm looks deeper into Hyun-Soo's past, as he is presented with his own belongings to help jog his memory.

videos.title: Return (1)
videos.overview: Hyun-Soo's whereabouts are unknown, and no one knows just how much of his memory has returned.

videos.title: Return (2)
videos.overview: Ji-Wook must tell Bong-Hee the truth about their parents' deaths. District Attorney Jang re-examines his son's murder case.

videos.title: In Court (1)
videos.overview: District Attorney Jang and Hyun-Soo disappear together. Ji-Wook and Bong-Hee search for them, afraid of what might happen.

videos.title: In Court (2)
videos.overview: Hyun-Soo's trial begins, but Ji-Wook doesn't plan to charge him with murder. Instead, he comes up with a new plan.

videos.title: Return to the Daily Life (1)
videos.overview: Bong-Hee worries about all that could go wrong if she gets back together with Ji-Wook. Hyun-Soo's final trial arrives.

videos.title: Return to the Daily Life (2)
videos.overview: A new case causes conflict between Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook as they learn more about how to love each other.
